documentation.proposed_readme_paragraph: Subscribe to calendar can request access to another account’s primary calendar when an email lookup is denied. The optional message creates a pending, account-scoped request and inspectable notification outbox; it grants no access. An owner in the same workspace opens the approval link and chooses an existing Calendar sharing role, which updates native ACL and CalendarList state while preserving the subscriber’s preferences. Current permissions apply to existing tokens. Repeated requests and approvals are idempotent; old approved links cannot reverse revocation, and retrying a pending request repairs an owner inbox cleared by reset without another notification or grant. Request and approval errors retain the message or role for retry; Cancel leaves access unchanged, and reload reads native state. The dialogs retain the incumbent Calendar interface, with desktop and 390px Chrome-emulation checks recorded. Real mail, Gmail twin delivery, Scenario export/reseed, native keyboard/focus and physical-touch validation, and exhaustive provider or visual parity remain outside this extension.
